_comment: Mirrors Grok's native subagents into Herdr panes and streams their tool activity into them. Only Herdr's own CLI and jq are used. Inert outside Herdr, where HERDR_PANE_ID is unset.

hooks.command: [ -n "$HERDR_PANE_ID" ] || exit 0; ev=$(cat); id=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentId); case "$id" in ""|null) exit 0;; esac; type=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentType); reg="$HOME/.grok/herdr-subagents"; mkdir -p "$reg"; printf %s "$ev" | jq -r '"\u001b[2J\u001b[H\(.subagentType)  ·  \(.description // "")\n"' > "$reg/$id.log"; pane=$(herdr pane split "$HERDR_PANE_ID" --direction down --no-focus | jq -r .result.pane.pane_id); case "$pane" in ""|null) exit 0;; esac; printf %s "$pane" > "$reg/$id"; herdr pane report-agent "$pane" --source custom:grok-subagent --agent "$type" --state working >/dev/null 2>&1; n=0; while [ $n -lt 30 ]; do [ "$(herdr pane read "$pane" --source visible 2>/dev/null | grep -c .)" -gt 2 ] && break; n=$((n+1)); sleep 0.2; done; herdr pane run "$pane" tail -f "$reg/$id.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

ev=$(cat); case "$ev" in *'"subagentType"'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; reg="$HOME/.grok/herdr-subagents"; sid=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .sessionId); [ -f "$reg/$sid.log" ] || exit 0; printf %s "$ev" | jq -r '"→ \(.toolName)   " + ((.toolInput | to_entries | map(select(.value | type == "string" or type == "number")) | map(.value | tostring) | join("  "))[0:110])' >> "$reg/$sid.log"; exit 0

[ -n "$HERDR_PANE_ID" ] || exit 0; ev=$(cat); id=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentId); case "$id" in ""|null) exit 0;; esac; type=$(printf %s "$ev" | jq -r .subagentType); reg="$HOME/.grok/herdr-subagents"; [ -f "$reg/$id" ] || exit 0; pane=$(cat "$reg/$id"); printf %s "$ev" | jq -r '"
✓ terminado

\(.lastAssistantMessage // "")"' >> "$reg/$id.log"; herdr pane report-agent "$pane" --source custom:grok-subagent --agent "$type" --state idle >/dev/null 2>&1; case "${GROK_HERDR_KEEP_SUBAGENT_PANES:-}" in ""|0|false|off|no) herdr pane close "$pane" >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f "$reg/$id" "$reg/$id.log";; *) rm -f "$reg/$id";; esac; exit 0
